title: Extent of Act
text:
17. Extent of Act.—This Act shall in the first instance extend only to the territories under the

government of the Lieutenant Governor of the North-West Provinces of the Presidency of Fort William in
Bengal.

Power to Governor General in Council to extend this Act.—But it shall be lawful for the State

Government, by notification in the Local Gazette, to extend this Act, mutatis _mutandis, to any other part_
of the [the territories under its government], except the towns of Calcutta, Madras and Bombay
